purpose: Define before evaluation what counts as transferable market intelligence so the future profitable-mind research cannot cherry-pick attractive post-hoc microstructure findings.

direction_or_magnitude_information.requirement: Must satisfy the already frozen teacher model stability rule across at least three of four historical evaluation regimes.
direction_or_magnitude_information.allowed_future_role: candidate contextual information in a separately pre-registered future generation

stable_feature_relationship.requirement: Teacher absolute Spearman >= 0.02, same sign in at least three of four evaluation folds, and median absolute evaluation Spearman >= 0.02.
stable_feature_relationship.allowed_future_role: candidate compact state variable or family

ofi_incremental_information.requirement: Full model must beat the otherwise identical no-OFI model on both MAE and log loss in at least three of four folds under a fixed model family.
ofi_incremental_information.allowed_future_role: OFI may be retained as distinct causal information rather than redundant imbalance

trust_or_uncertainty_information.requirement: Teacher-defined bad-state quintile must have at least 1.10x forecast error versus good-state quintile in at least three of four folds.
trust_or_uncertainty_information.allowed_future_role: candidate confidence/risk-context input; cannot become a hard trade gate from this study

rejected_as_nontransferable: relationship seen only in one or two historical regimes
relationship whose sign flips across most regimes
result found only by one coin and unsupported across the four-coin panel
metric improvement requiring post-result threshold or hyperparameter changes
isolated high win rate or return without frozen cross-regime stability
any conclusion requiring fabricated or interpolated missing order-book history

future_generation_rule.avoid_hard_gate_by_default: GEN3D/GEN3E experience shows hard filtering can overfit or collapse opportunity coverage; any future gate requires independent preregistration and justification.
